shared_elements: quadruped animals shown in strict profile
horizontal band or register dividing the field
animal with open mouth / bared teeth
repeated animals moving in the same direction
justification: Both are stone reliefs featuring profile quadrupeds arranged in a directional sequence, with a disc form and at least one horizontal banded division, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is a single wide horizontal narrative scene with fine incised interior detail and modelled, naturalistic bodies, whereas B is a tall vertically stacked composition of bold, schematic, heavily projecting figures on an irregular pillar face — the manner of cutting and the framing logic are quite different.
